title: feat(console): edit a dashboard on its own page, and mark the page filters a card does not follow
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUeSU9HhKxjcVsyprx

Fixes #36372

Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new exported core function (`dashboardFiltersNotApplied`), two new optional `DashboardRenderer` props (`onWidgetResize`, `onAddFilter`), and new `@object-ui/i18n` keys (`dashboard.inPageEdit.*`, `dashboard.filters.notApplied`, `dashboard.filters.addFilter`); nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：系统管理员在仪表盘页面上点「编辑」就能直接改：拖动和拉伸卡片、点卡片在右侧改属性、添加和删除卡片、添加和修改顶部筛选、设置每张卡片是否跟随页面筛选。「保存」后所有人立刻看到，不需要发布应用包；「放弃」丢掉全部改动。
- 为什么：以前改仪表盘必须进入工作室，管理员在看数据时发现问题要绕一大圈；现在在哪里看就在哪里改。
- 对已安装的应用：改动写进该应用的定制层（和工作室的「定制」写同一处），升级应用不会覆盖。点「编辑」本身什么都不写，定制层在第一次「保存」时才创建，所以「编辑」后「放弃」不留下任何东西。工作室不让定制的情况（本部署只有平台运营方能定制已安装应用、软件包列表没给出版本），页面也不进入编辑，并说明原因；如果工作室里已有这张仪表盘未发布的草稿，页面会提示先去工作室处理，不会替别人发布。
- 另外：每张卡片都会显示一个小标记，写明它不跟随哪些页面筛选（例如「不跟随『区域』筛选」），标记和卡片实际查到的数据用的是同一条判断，不会对不上。

## What changes

**Edit state on the dashboard page** (`DashboardView` + new `DashboardInPageEditor.tsx`). A workspace admin who may author metadata, on a package Studio lists (`useStudioEntryGate`, the gate of the app → Studio entries; writable or read-only, never a kernel package), gets an **Edit** button in the page header (from `sm` up: the edit state needs its side panel). Edit opens the dashboard **as stored** — the layered read's `effective` in the package a save would land in (a customization pair that is not listed yet, or does not hold it yet, opens its base's) — never the served, translated copy. **Opening writes nothing**: it reads the package list and the item only. In the edit state:

- the header shows an **Editing** badge, the hint "Saved changes apply to everyone at once", and **Add card**, **Discard**, **Save** (Save is off until something changes);
- every card draws dashed and is in the renderer's design mode: drag to move (the existing dnd-kit reorder), click to select, and a new corner handle resizes it by whole grid tracks;
- the right panel is Studio's own dashboard panels, unchanged: `DashboardWidgetInspector` for a selected card (its data, the "follow page filters" switches, Remove) and `DashboardDefaultInspector` otherwise (label, cards, filters, layout);
- **Add card** appends a card at the end (Studio's id and defaults) and selects it; **Add filter**, drawn at the end of the filter bar, opens the panel's Filters section.

**Save** (`saveDashboardInPlace`) is the confirmed-save door of #35955 (ruling 7058616478): the body is staged as the item's draft under the first-write pin and that one item is published in the same act — no package-wide publish-drafts. Where it lands is read at open by `resolveDashboardEditTarget` (package list only): the owning package when the list carries it writable, else the app's customization package, whose id is taken from the list when it is already listed (`listedCustomizationPairOf`, the read Studio makes of a pair). At Save, and only there, `ensureDashboardSaveTarget` asks the ensure door for the pair (it creates `<base>.custom` on first use, as Studio's first saved customization does), and the body declares `overrides: { package, basedOn }` (`overrideDraftBody`, the body Studio's Customize writes; ADR-0146 D2/D3). So an installed app's dashboard is edited too, through the same doors Studio uses. The edit state is refused up front where Studio's Customize is: the ensure door walled for this caller (`useCustomizeDoorWalled`, toast "only the platform operator can customize an installed app's dashboard") and a base listing no version to declare the override at when the item declares none yet (Studio's `noVersion`). Over a draft already pending there, the edit state is not entered, and a save that races one writes nothing (`'pending-draft'`): a Studio draft is never published on its saver's behalf. **Discard** drops the buffer and writes nothing. After a save the bundle re-read keeps the shown dashboard standing, so the page does not flash its skeleton. The edit state draws the stored document with the served `_packageId` beside it, so its cards' dataset queries keep naming the dashboard's package (`callerPackage`, ADR-0150 D3) as in view mode; a save drops `_` keys.

**The not-filtered mark** (`plugin-dashboard`). Every card, in every mode, names the page filters that do not reach it ("Not filtered by Region and Owner"; zh 「不跟随『区域和负责人』筛选」): a filter it opts out of (`filterBindings[name]: false`) or one whose `targetWidgets` leaves it out (an explicit string binding wins over `targetWidgets`). The built-in date filter is named as the bar names it ("Date range"), never by its reserved name. The list is the new core `dashboardFiltersNotApplied(widget, defs)`, which asks `resolveBoundField` — the binding `buildWidgetScopedFilter` builds the card's query from — so the mark and the data cannot disagree. A card every filter reaches carries none.

**Renderer design mode** gains two opt-in affordances: `onWidgetResize(widgetId, { w, h })` draws the corner handle (snaps as the pointer crosses half a track; arrow keys step by one; width clamped to the grid's columns; not drawn on a phone), and `onAddFilter()` draws "Add filter" in the filter bar (the bar is drawn for it even before any filter exists). Studio's canvas passes neither, so it is unchanged.

**Persistence seam.** `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` itself is unchanged: `saveDashboardInPlace` hands it a client that names the target package on the three writes it makes (draft, publish, discard of a refused publish).

Studio is not touched; panel wording is #36373's (not touched here).

ADR: this realises the in-app half of the ADR-0146 D1 amendment row "ADR-0146 D1, \"Studio owns all metadata\"" that seat 7 filed on the weekly ADR card #36086 (epic #36359); no `docs/adr` edit here. Persistence stays on the ADR-0034 runtime metadata seam (draft + per-item publish through `/meta`).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/dashboard-filters.test.ts` — `dashboardFiltersNotApplied` agrees with `buildWidgetScopedFilter` for default, opted-out, rebound, `targetWidgets`-listed and explicit-over-list widgets.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.filters.test.tsx` — the mark is on the opted-out card and only it, a rebound card has none, a `targetWidgets`-excluded card has it, an opted-out built-in date filter reads "Not filtered by Date range"; each case reads the query's `runtimeFilter` beside the mark.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.designMode.test.tsx` — the corner handle only with `onWidgetResize` in design mode, keyboard resize, no card selection from the handle; "Add filter" only in design mode, drawn before any filter exists.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/designAffordances.test.ts` — `resizedSpan` snapping and clamps.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts` — edit target read from the list only (writable package; read-only package with no pair listed: none named, ensure not called; a listed pair named for reading; unbound; refusal), the ensure door asked at save (pair with `basedOn`; refusal and non-writable pair throw), the save body, the target package named on draft/publish/discard, pending-draft writes nothing.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardInPageEditor.test.ts` — opening (owner's layered `effective`; an installed app with no pair yet opens its base's reading no pair and with no ensure door at all; a listed pair that does not hold it opens its base's; refused when walled and when no version is listed, but not for an item that already declares its override; refused over a pending draft without reading; refusals), add card, resize keeps unnamed coordinates.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.inPageEdit-36372.test.tsx` — through the real `DashboardView` and renderer: no Edit button behind the gate; Edit opens the stored document in design mode with badge and panel; resize + Save stages and publishes in the owning package and leaves the edit state; an installed package asks the ensure door at Save only and saves into `crm.custom` declaring the override; **Edit then Discard on an installed app calls the ensure door zero times and writes nothing**; a walled door refuses with its reason; a dataset card in the edit state still queries with `callerPackage` (ablated: red without the fix); a pending draft refuses; Discard writes nothing.

## Acceptance notes

**Live run** (L1-e's REWORK) on head `f0750e0dd`: a fresh local showcase backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, file DB) and the console from source (`ui/apps/console` Vite against it), driven by Playwright as the seeded admin. The writable leg uses a package created over REST (`com.example.livedash`, depending on `com.example.showcase`) holding an app and a four-card dashboard with one card opted out of the date range; the installed leg uses showcase's own `showcase_ops_dashboard` (`com.example.showcase`, listed read-only, version 0.1.0).

| Acceptance | Reading |
|---|---|
| Writable: drag, widen, add, delete, Save | Dragged "Priority Mix" to the front, widened "Tasks all time" by its corner (192 → 400 px, `w` 3 → 6), added a Metric card (given its dataset and measure in the panel; Save without them is refused by the server, 422 `widgets.N.dataset`, shown in the "could not be saved" toast with that reason), removed "Tasks by Status" through the panel. Writes on **Edit**: none. Writes on **Save**: exactly `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/livedash_board?mode=draft&package=com.example.livedash` (200, `state=draft`) then `POST …/livedash_board/publish?package=com.example.livedash` (200). No `/packages/:id/publish-drafts`. |
| After a reload the layout holds | The served dashboard reads `w_priority, w_tasks, w_all_time (w 6), widget_1`; the page draws that order, the widened card, the added "Open tasks (added live)" and no "Tasks by Status". |
| Installed app: Edit then Discard | Writes on Edit: none; package list before and after Edit → change → Discard: `["com.example.showcase"]` (no `.custom` created); the page shows the original titles. |
| Installed app: Save lands in `<base>.custom` | Writes on Save: `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`, `PUT …/showcase_ops_dashboard?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides: { package: "com.example.showcase", basedOn: "0.1.0" }` (server: "Saved customization overlay"), `POST …/publish?package=com.example.showcase.custom`. After a reload the page shows "Total Budget (customized live)". Studio's Interfaces (`/studio/com.example.showcase/interfaces?surface=dashboard:showcase_ops_dashboard`) shows the same title, the "Overrides ObjectStack Showcase" badge and "Only customizations (1)". |
| Discard after a change | Covered in the installed leg above: the page is as before and nothing is written. |
| Mark on an opted-out time-filter card | "Tasks all time" (`filterBindings: { dateRange: false }`) reads "Not filtered by Date range"; no other card is marked. Last 90 days: follows 10, all-time 10; Yesterday: follows 1, all-time **10** (unchanged). |
| Its switch turned on and saved | The panel's dateRange "Apply" checkbox on that card, then Save: the body's card has no `filterBindings`; draft + per-item publish only. After a reload: no mark on any card; Yesterday: follows 1, all-time **1** (now follows). |

The live run found two defects, fixed in `f0750e0dd` and pinned: the mark named the built-in date filter by its reserved name ("dateRange"), and the edit state's dataset queries dropped `?callerPackage=` (the stored document carries no `_packageId`).

**Screenshots** (live run, 2× scale) are in the project's shared files, under `repo-objectstack-7/shots/36372/`; they cannot be uploaded to GitHub from the cloud seat, as on #36397. They replace the harness shots.
- `live-en-edit-writable.png` — edit state on the writable dashboard: Editing badge, hint, Add card / Discard / Save, dashed cards, the widened card selected with its panel, the marked card.
- `live-en-view-marked-card.png` — view mode with "Not filtered by Date range" on the opted-out card, under "Yesterday".
- `live-en-edit-installed.png`, `live-zh-edit-installed.png` — edit state on the installed showcase dashboard (zh: 「编辑中」「保存后所有人立刻看到」, five cards marked 「不跟随「Task Status」筛选」).
- `live-en-after-reload-writable.png`, `live-en-after-reload-installed.png`, `live-en-studio-interfaces.png`, `live-en-view-after-switch-on.png` — the after-reload and Studio readings above.

**Known gap** (not in this card): leaving the page in the edit state with unsaved changes drops them without asking. #36362's unsaved-edits seam (`useRegisterUnsavedEdits`) is the place to register it, in a later card.

Undo, a business user's own copy, a new dashboard, chart drawing and drill-down are out of scope, per the card.

## Verification

- At `f0750e0dd`: type check `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` green; `packages/plugin-dashboard/src`, the dashboard view / editor / persistence files, `core` dashboard-filters and `AppContent.dashboardRouteReads-28784` — 223 files, 2213 tests green; `packages/i18n/src/__tests__` 106 files green; `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-dead-keys` green. `overlap-check`: clean against main and 7 open PRs (#36398 included).
- At `3e7995a73` (before this round): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 72 derived families all run and accounted (`--ran`); four first-pass reds re-run exit 0 (comment-mask sweep reading a deleted harness file, `vitest run scripts/` killed for memory, `check:skill-examples` prerequisite, `check:test-source-alias` fixed in the tests). This round's diff (app-shell editor, two i18n keys in every locale, the mark's label, docs) is left to CI's gates.
